title: Pseudo-coherence is closed under distinguished triangles
statement: Let Y be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let A \to B \to C \to A[1] be a distinguished triangle in D(\mathcal O_Y) [def-pc-derived-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. If A and C are pseudo-coherent objects [def-pur-pseudo-coherent-complex], then B is pseudo-coherent.

source.place: Cohomology of Sheaves, section Pseudo-coherent modules, Tag 08CD (label lemma-cone-pseudo-coherent), part (2) applied for every m

proof.text: Pseudo-coherence is local on Y [def-pur-pseudo-coherent-complex]. Choose open coverings on which A, respectively C, is quasi-isomorphic to a bounded-above complex of finite free modules, and refine them to a common covering of Y by open affines $U=\operatorname{Spec}(R)$; restricting a finite free complex to a smaller open keeps it finite free, and restriction $D(\mathcal O_Y)\to D(\mathcal O_U)$ is exact, so $A|_U\to B|_U\to C|_U\to A|_U[1]$ is distinguished. It suffices to show $B|_U$ is quasi-isomorphic to a bounded-above complex of finite free $\mathcal O_U$-modules.

On $U=\operatorname{Spec}(R)$ a bounded-above complex of finite free $\mathcal O_U$-modules is $\widetilde{P^\bullet}$ for a bounded-above complex $P^\bullet$ of finite free $R$-modules (a map $\mathcal O_U^{a}\to\mathcal O_U^{b}$ is a matrix over $R$), so $A|_U\cong\widetilde{P_A}$ and $C|_U\cong\widetilde{P_C}$ lie in $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_U)$. Rotating by (TR2) of [def-weil-triangulated-category] gives a distinguished triangle $C|_U[-1]\xrightarrow{u}A|_U\to B|_U\to C|_U$. Since $M^\bullet\mapsto\widetilde{M^\bullet}$ is an equivalence $D(R)\to D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_U)$ [lem-pc-affine-qcoh-derived-equivalence], $u$ is the image of a unique morphism $u_R:P_C[-1]\to P_A$ in $D(R)$. The complex $P_C[-1]$ is bounded above with projective terms, hence K-projective [lem-sc-bounded-above-projective-kprojective]; so $\operatorname{Hom}_{K(R)}(P_C[-1],-)$ inverts quasi-isomorphisms and $u_R$ is represented by a chain map $g:P_C[-1]\to P_A$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category].

source.place: Tag 08CD, lemma-cone-pseudo-coherent, part (2), lifting the map to complexes (affine form via Tag 06Z0)

proof.text: The mapping cone $C(g)$ has terms $P_A^r\oplus P_C^{r}$ (the $(r+1)$-st term of $P_C[-1]$), so it is bounded above with finite free terms, and $P_C[-1]\xrightarrow{g}P_A\to C(g)\to P_C$ is distinguished in $D(R)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. The equivalence of [lem-pc-affine-qcoh-derived-equivalence] is triangulated, so its image $C|_U[-1]\xrightarrow{u}A|_U\to\widetilde{C(g)}\to C|_U$ is distinguished in $D(\mathcal O_U)$; two distinguished triangles on the same morphism $u$ have isomorphic third terms ((TR3) of [def-weil-triangulated-category] and the five lemma on $\operatorname{Hom}$), so $B|_U\cong\widetilde{C(g)}$, a bounded-above complex of finite free $\mathcal O_U$-modules. By Step 1, B is pseudo-coherent on Y.
